text.mappe.geaendert: A folder has been saved with changes; with the keys of the changed fields. Rapid series of changes become one event.
text.mappe.verknuepft: Another folder now links to this folder (e.g. an invoice to its contract).
text.dokument.hochgeladen: A document has been uploaded to a folder.
text.mappe.notiz: A note has been added to a folder.
text.mappe.geloescht: A folder is in the bin (or has been deleted without a bin).
text.mappe.geloescht-verknuepft: A folder went to the bin together with the folders that belong to it – one event per folder with the same operation.
text.mappe.endgueltig-geloescht: A folder has been permanently deleted (bin emptied or without a bin).
text.mappe.wiederhergestellt: A folder is back from the bin.
text.frist.erreicht: A date field with a reminder has been reached: at the reminder time (lead time) and on the day itself – once per point in time.
text.aufgabe.neu: A task has come up for someone (also a deadline, reminder, new post).
text.post.angelegt: New post has been created (uploaded, by email, scan …).
text.favorit.neu: Someone added a folder to their favourites.
text.favorit.geaendert: Someone changed a folder that others have as a favourite and want to be notified about.
text.benutzer.abwesenheit-gesetzt: A user is absent (with period and stand-in).
text.benutzer.abwesenheit-beendet: A user’s absence has been turned off.
text.benutzer.vertretung-zurueckgezogen: Someone is no longer a user’s stand-in – the absence ends or another stand-in has been entered.
text.benutzer.gesperrt: Sign-in protection locked an account after failed attempts.
text.benutzer.aktiviert: A deactivated user is active again.
text.volltext.fertig: A document’s full text is final (even without text).
text.datei.umgewandelt: A package has stored a readable version of a document (e.g. PDF from TIFF).
text.archivfassung.erstellt: A package has stored the archive version (PDF/A) of a document.
text.erkennung.fertig: Recognition has analysed a piece of post (sender, assignment).
text.sicherung.fertig: A backup is finished (encrypted) and can be copied off-site – for packages with a backup destination.
text.paket.einstellungen-geaendert: Job for a package: its settings have been changed.
text.datei.umwandeln: Job for a package: a file is to be converted (file types Ablago doesn’t read itself).
text.datei.volltext: Job for a package: a file needs its full text (file types Ablago doesn’t read itself).
text.datei.archivfassung: Job for a package: a document with finished full text (emails also without) needs its archive version (PDF/A).
text.zeitplan.ausgefuehrt: Job for a package: an automation with the card “Run package on schedule” has run at its time – with task, date and planned time.
